heading: Swift: public configuration in native Tac
body: Swift runs as native Tac on macOS and iOS, and as WebAssembly in the browser. It is not a Yon language. Only the public tac configuration may enter client code. The build publishes client/manifest.json, including its tac member, at /manifest.webmanifest. In the browser, a Swift service loads it through an HTTPClient (see Public Tac output and private Yon lifetime). A native service uses a loader that it owns, or public input. This short Swift service binds a public snapshot that it gets as input. The Settings and Setting classes are structs in `client/models/` (ADR 0092), and the service carries Service. It does not touch the private Yon configuration or .env. Nothing is injected here: the service binds the snapshot in its init.
